bio: Lynn Bartholomew served with The Navigators and at her church discipling women in the Christian faith, teaching them how to live with wisdom and in response to the gospel. In Isaiah 56:5, is God's promise to those who devote their lives of singleness in service to Him: In my house and within my wall a monument and a name better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name that shall not be cut off. And God did indeed give that inheritance to her, evidenced by the many lives that were changed through her ministry and influence.
